# Example denylist for CI. Generic patterns only.
#
# This file is scanned by nothing: leak-check skips the denylist it was handed.
# Keep your REAL denylist outside the repository — it holds exactly the strings
# that must never appear inside it, so committing it defeats the purpose.
#
# One term or regex per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. An entry
# that is not valid regex syntax is matched literally. Matching is case-insensitive.
